# 0.15.157

**A friend whose Blackline is too old to reach you is now told apart from one who is offline — and
the call, the control banner and theatre all sit where they should.**

## "Online, but nothing goes through"

Derek and Muffin, 17 October: both on desktops, both shown online, and nothing passed — messages
sat, and her call went to a waiting screen with both pictures on it while his never rang. Her laptop
was on a September build and his on 0.15.156. Being shown online is not version-gated; a link is. So
each looked present and nothing could ever cross.

Blackline already had a line for exactly this, and it could never appear: a greeting from another
version was thrown away as unreadable before the part that says *who has to update* ever saw it.
Fixed. Now, when a friend's build is too old to talk to yours:

- the conversation's header says **Their Blackline needs updating**;
- the details pane says it is not connected and connects by itself once they update;
- the message bar says what you send is **kept on this device and sends once they update** — not
  "until they are back", which was never going to happen;
- and all of it goes the moment they do: they link, and what was waiting is delivered.

Walked end to end against a real September build (`test/e2e-stale.mjs`): no link for 90 s, the
warning everywhere, then the friend updates, links in about 3 s, the stuck message arrives and the
warning clears. A friend on an old build will still need to install this one by hand once — an old
build cannot be reached by the new one, which is the whole problem.

## The call is at the top again

In a short conversation, a call sat in the middle of the screen with a band of nothing above it. A
layout rule still described the conversation as three rows after a fourth (the call bar) was added in
0.15.110, and the spare space went to the empty row. Fixed.

## The control banner

When someone is controlling your computer, the banner is no longer a solid red slab above the
window. It sits **under the title bar**, in the app's own colours with a red edge, names who it is,
the key that stops it, and one red **Stop now** button. Two faults found on the way:

- **Stop did nothing after the banner redrew.** The button was replaced on every redraw and lost its
  click. It now always works, with Enter and Space too. (The stop key was never affected.)
- **The popped-out call never showed the banner** — and that is the window you are looking at while
  it happens. It does now, without covering the call.

## No pulsing dots

The banner's dot and the call tile's live dot pulsed. They are still now.

## Theatre stays a message

A video watched big used to stick to the top of the conversation and cover every message that
scrolled under it. Now it grows **in its own message**, keeps its words, and scrolls with the
conversation like anything else; it grows in place and never covers another message
(`test/e2e-theatre.mjs` checks every scroll position).

## Tests that had stopped testing

- `e2e-voice` was red because it tested an interface that had moved on — and its "N people in here"
  checks were reading a hidden button, so they passed whatever the screen said. It reads the call bar
  now, and passes.
- `e2e-control`'s intermittent failure was the test clicking a resting control bar without moving
  the mouse first, which no hand can do.

## Still open

- A space still does not reach a second device of the same account.
- `e2e-calls` step 16 (a call after both cores restart) is red, as it was before.
- Screen-share sharpness and lip sync are being measured now; nothing in this release changes them.
